## What's new in 1.2.1

### A visualizer you can feel
- **Soft light now swells up from the bottom with the music**, on the Media page and in the fullscreen player. Big glowing blobs rise with their part of the sound, bass on the left through to the highs on the right, and drift slowly along the floor.
- It listens to the actual frequencies of what's playing instead of just the overall volume, and adjusts itself to the song, so quiet tracks move as much as loud ones.
- The audio analyser behind it only runs while the visualizer is on screen and stops a few seconds after you leave.

### Smoother
- **Shuffle and loop show a dot when they're on**, on the Media page and in the fullscreen player, which now has shuffle and loop buttons too.
- **Side pills show the song.** On the left and right edges, the pill over a maximized window now shows the title and artist written vertically, like a book spine.
- **Sheets crossfade.** Opening Settings, Bluetooth or Wi-Fi now fades the page out as the sheet fades in, instead of showing both at once.
- **The tray menu is readable in Glass** again, with a solid dark version of your glass colors.

### Lighter
- The fullscreen player draws at half rate while the music is paused or silent.
